reuse.why: Factors the hidden clause into a small visibleCategoriesFilter helper and keeps isFixedCostGroup, but leaves the five copied category queries in place instead of one shared selection.

duplication.why: The same SQL query and the same flag edit are repeated across setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three averages, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden check in JS, so the hidden rule still lives in two forms.

placement.why: The helper sits in server/budget/actions.ts with the actions, but the category-selection rule remains scattered across each action rather than in one selection function.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, a shared options type and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: copyPreviousMonth, a month-wide action, was not given the flag, and any future selection change still needs edits in five queries plus a JS filter.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection abstraction existed; isFixedCostGroup is still used.

disguised_duplication.where: The five category queries stay openly duplicated; only the hidden fragment was extracted.
